detail: Baton needs M03's branch m03 to contain the commit that last changed docs/milestones/M03.md on main, because the session reads its brief in that worktree. The branch does not contain that commit and has no worktree yet. Create the worktree on that branch and merge main into it yourself: git -C '@TMP@/Fixture' worktree add '@TMP@/Fixture-M03' 'm03' && git -C '@TMP@/Fixture-M03' merge main
